name: REBREATHERS
text: Friendly Imperial Navy Breachers may disregard changes to their APL (in this game only reductions are disregarded), and Shock on enemy weapons has no effect on them.

name: SLUGS
text: Three uses per turning point across the team. When a friendly Imperial Navy Breacher that is shooting picks its Navis shotgun (long range), spend a use: for that action the weapon hits 1 better, deals 1 more normal and critical damage, and gains Accurate 1.

name: COMBAT STIMMS
text: Friendly Imperial Navy Breacher operatives ignore the Move reduction from being injured. The Hit penalty still applies.

name: SYSTEM OVERRIDE DEVICE
text: One friendly Imperial Navy Breacher per turning point may Operate Hatch at 1 AP less. Hatchways exist only in close-quarters killzones, so this has no effect in the open killzone.
